concepts.def: Boosts muscle growth and strength — banned.
Reduces tremor and HR — banned in fine-skill sports.
Boosts red blood cells — increases oxygen carry.
Personal Protective Equipment — pads, helmets, mouthguards.
Raises temperature and mobility — prevents injury.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Reduce injury risk by:

  • Proper warm-up and cool-down.
  • Correct technique.
  • Suitable PPE — helmets, shin pads, mouthguards.
  • Following rules.
  • Balanced progressive overload avoiding overtraining.

Anabolic steroids build muscle (used in power events) — side effects: liver damage, mood swings. Beta blockers reduce tremor (archery, snooker). EPO boosts red cells (endurance). Stimulants raise alertness — but increase heart attack risk.
PEDs are banned because they are unsafe (serious side effects), unfair (cheating clean athletes) and damage the image of sport. WADA tests athletes; positive tests bring bans and stripped medals.
